WITH FactAverageDailyBalanceMTD_MTD AS (
SELECT
max(MTD.BusinessDateSK) AS BusinessDateSK
,DC.CustomerSK AS CustomerSK
,DC.CustomerId AS CustomerId
,SUM(MTD.AverageDailBalanceAmountMTDProrated) AS AverageDailyBalanceMonthToDate
FROM DW.DimCustomer DC
LEFT JOIN DW.DimCustomerAccount DCA ON DC.CustomerSK = DCA.CustomerSK
LEFT JOIN DW.DimAccount DA ON DCA.AccountSK = DA.AccountSK
LEFT JOIN DW.FactAverageDailyBalanceMTD MTD ON DCA.AccountSK = MTD.AccountSK AND MTD.BusinessDateSK=(20230209)
WHERE DA.AccountStatus != 'Closed' 
AND DCA.ShareIndicator = 'Y'
AND DC.CurrentIndicator = 1 AND DCA.CurrentIndicator = 1 AND DA.CurrentIndicator = 1 ---UPDATED_20230721
GROUP BY DC.CustomerSK,DC.CustomerId
)

,FactAverageDailyBalanceYTD_YTD AS (
SELECT
MAX(YTD.BusinessDateSK) AS BusinessDateSK
,DC.CustomerSK AS CustomerSK
,DC.CustomerId AS CustomerId
,SUM(YTD.AverageDailBalanceAmountYTDProrated) AS AverageDailyBalanceYearToDate
,SUM(YTD.AverageDailBalanceAmountYTDFull) AS AverageDailyBalanceYearToDate_Full
FROM DW.DimCustomer DC
LEFT JOIN DW.DimCustomerAccount DCA ON DC.CustomerSK = DCA.CustomerSK
LEFT JOIN DW.DimAccount DA ON DCA.AccountSK = DA.AccountSK
LEFT JOIN DW.FactAverageDailyBalanceYTD YTD ON DCA.AccountSK = YTD.AccountSK AND YTD.BusinessDateSK=(SELECT MAX(BusinessDateSK) FROM DW.FactAverageDailyBalanceYTD)
WHERE DA.AccountStatus != 'Closed'
AND DCA.ShareIndicator = 'Y'
AND DC.CurrentIndicator = 1 AND DCA.CurrentIndicator = 1 AND DA.CurrentIndicator = 1 ---UPDATED_20230721
GROUP BY DC.CustomerSK,DC.CustomerId
)

,FactDepositsOutstandingBalance_DOB AS (
SELECT
MAX(DOB.BusinessDateSK) AS BusinessDateSK
,DC.CustomerSK AS CustomerSK
,DC.CustomerId AS CustomerId
,SUM(DOB.BalanceAmountProrated) AS DepositsOutstandingBalance
FROM DW.DimCustomer DC
LEFT JOIN DW.DimCustomerAccount DCA ON DC.CustomerSK = DCA.CustomerSK
LEFT JOIN DW.DimAccount DA ON DCA.AccountSK = DA.AccountSK
LEFT JOIN DW.FactDepositsOutstandingBalance DOB ON DCA.AccountSK = DOB.AccountSK AND DOB.BusinessDateSK='20230209'---(SELECT MAX(BusinessDateSK) FROM DW.FactDepositsOutstandingBalance)
WHERE DA.AccountStatus != 'Closed'
AND DCA.ShareIndicator = 'Y'
AND DC.CurrentIndicator = 1 AND DCA.CurrentIndicator = 1 AND DA.CurrentIndicator = 1 ---UPDATED_20230721
GROUP BY DC.CustomerSK,DC.CustomerId
)

,FactLoansRelationshipExposure_LRE AS (
SELECT
MAX(LRE.BusinessDateSK) AS BusinessDateSK
,DC.CustomerSK AS CustomerSK
,DC.CustomerId AS CustomerId
,SUM(LRE.TotalRelationshipExposureProrated) AS LoansRelationshipExposure
,SUM(LRE.TotalRelationshipExposureFull) AS LoansRelationshipExposureFull
FROM DW.DimCustomer DC
LEFT JOIN DW.DimCustomerAccount DCA ON DC.CustomerSK = DCA.CustomerSK
LEFT JOIN DW.DimAccount DA ON DCA.AccountSK = DA.AccountSK
LEFT JOIN DW.FactLoansRelationshipExposure LRE ON DCA.AccountSK = LRE.AccountSK AND LRE.BusinessDateSK=(SELECT MAX(BusinessDateSK) FROM DW.FactLoansRelationshipExposure)
WHERE DA.AccountStatus != 'Closed'
AND DCA.ShareIndicator = 'Y'
AND DC.CurrentIndicator = 1 AND DCA.CurrentIndicator = 1 AND DA.CurrentIndicator = 1 ---UPDATED_20230721
GROUP BY DC.CustomerSK,DC.CustomerId
)

,FactLoansOutstandingBalance_LOB AS (
SELECT
MAX(LOB.BusinessDateSK) AS BusinessDateSK
,DC.CustomerSK AS CustomerSK
,DC.CustomerId AS CustomerId
,SUM(LOB.OutstandingBalanceProrated) AS LoansOutstanstandingBalance
,SUM(LOB.OutstandingBalanceFull) AS LoansOutstanstandingBalanceFull
FROM DW.DimCustomer DC
LEFT JOIN DW.DimCustomerAccount DCA ON DC.CustomerSK = DCA.CustomerSK
LEFT JOIN DW.DimAccount DA ON DCA.AccountSK = DA.AccountSK
LEFT JOIN DW.FactLoansOutstandingBalance LOB ON DCA.AccountSK = LOB.AccountSK AND LOB.BusinessDateSK=(SELECT MAX(BusinessDateSK) FROM DW.FactLoansOutstandingBalance)
WHERE DA.AccountStatus != 'Closed'
AND DCA.ShareIndicator = 'Y'
AND DC.CurrentIndicator = 1 AND DCA.CurrentIndicator = 1 AND DA.CurrentIndicator = 1 ---UPDATED_20230721
GROUP BY DC.CustomerSK,DC.CustomerId
)

,FactLoansCreditLimit_LCL AS (
SELECT
MAX(LCL.BusinessDateSK)AS BusinessDateSK
,DC.CustomerSK AS CustomerSK
,DC.CustomerId AS CustomerId
,SUM(LCL.CreditLimitAmountProrated) AS LoansCreditLimit
,SUM(LCL.CreditLimitAmountFull) AS LoansCreditLimitFull
FROM DW.DimCustomer DC
LEFT JOIN DW.DimCustomerAccount DCA ON DC.CustomerSK = DCA.CustomerSK
LEFT JOIN DW.DimAccount DA ON DCA.AccountSK = DA.AccountSK
LEFT JOIN DW.FactLoansCreditLimit LCL ON DCA.AccountSK = LCL.AccountSK AND LCL.BusinessDateSK=(SELECT MAX(BusinessDateSK) FROM DW.FactLoansCreditLimit)
WHERE DA.AccountStatus != 'Closed'
AND DCA.ShareIndicator = 'Y'
AND DC.CurrentIndicator = 1 AND DCA.CurrentIndicator = 1 AND DA.CurrentIndicator = 1 ---UPDATED_20230721
GROUP BY DC.CustomerSK,DC.CustomerId
)

,FactCardsCreditLimit_CCL AS (
SELECT
MAX(CCL.BusinessDateSK) AS BusinessDateSK
,DC.CustomerSK AS CustomerSK
,DC.CustomerId AS CustomerId
,SUM(CCL.CurrentCreditLimit) AS CardsCreditLimit
FROM DW.DimCustomer DC
LEFT JOIN DW.DimCustomerAccount DCA ON DC.CustomerSK = DCA.CustomerSK
LEFT JOIN DW.DimAccount DA ON DCA.AccountSK = DA.AccountSK
LEFT JOIN DW.FactCardsCreditLimit CCL ON DCA.AccountSK = CCL.AccountSK AND CCL.BusinessDateSK=(SELECT MAX(BusinessDateSK) FROM DW.FactCardsCreditLimit)
WHERE DA.AccountStatus != '8'
AND DCA.ShareIndicator = 'Y'
AND DC.CurrentIndicator = 1 AND DCA.CurrentIndicator = 1 AND DA.CurrentIndicator = 1 ---UPDATED_20230721
GROUP BY DC.CustomerSK,DC.CustomerId
)

,FactCardsOutstandingBalance_COB AS (
SELECT
MAX(COB.BusinessDateSK) AS BusinessDateSK
,DC.CustomerSK AS CustomerSK
,DC.CustomerId AS CustomerId
,SUM(COB.StatementBalance) AS CardsStatementBalance
FROM DW.DimCustomer DC
LEFT JOIN DW.DimCustomerAccount DCA ON DC.CustomerSK = DCA.CustomerSK
LEFT JOIN DW.DimAccount DA ON DCA.AccountSK = DA.AccountSK
LEFT JOIN DW.FactCardsOutstandingBalance COB ON DCA.AccountSK = COB.AccountSK AND COB.BusinessDateSK=(SELECT MAX(BusinessDateSK) FROM DW.FactCardsOutstandingBalance)
WHERE DA.AccountStatus != '8'
AND DCA.ShareIndicator = 'Y'
AND DC.CurrentIndicator = 1 AND DCA.CurrentIndicator = 1 AND DA.CurrentIndicator = 1 ---UPDATED_20230721
GROUP BY DC.CustomerSK,DC.CustomerId
)

,FactCardsRelationshipExposure_CRE AS (
SELECT
MAX(CRE.BusinessDateSK) AS BusinessDateSK
,DC.CustomerSK AS CustomerSK
,DC.CustomerId AS CustomerId
,SUM(CRE.RelationshipExposure) AS CardsRelationshipExposure
FROM DW.DimCustomer DC
LEFT JOIN DW.DimCustomerAccount DCA ON DC.CustomerSK = DCA.CustomerSK
LEFT JOIN DW.DimAccount DA ON DCA.AccountSK = DA.AccountSK
LEFT JOIN DW.FactCardsRelationshipExposure CRE ON DCA.AccountSK = CRE.AccountSK AND CRE.BusinessDateSK=(SELECT MAX(BusinessDateSK) FROM DW.FactCardsRelationshipExposure)
WHERE DA.AccountStatus != '8'
AND DCA.ShareIndicator = 'Y'
AND DC.CurrentIndicator = 1 AND DCA.CurrentIndicator = 1 AND DA.CurrentIndicator = 1 ---UPDATED_20230721
GROUP BY DC.CustomerSK,DC.CustomerId
)

,FactSecurityPortfolio_SP AS (
SELECT
MAX(SP.BusinessDateSK) AS BusinessDateSK
,DC.CustomerSK AS CustomerSK
,DC.CustomerId AS CustomerId
,SUM(SP.PortfolioEndValueProrated) AS SecuritiesPortfolio
FROM DW.DimCustomer DC
LEFT JOIN DW.DimCustomerAccount DCA ON DC.CustomerSK = DCA.CustomerSK
LEFT JOIN DW.DimAccount DA ON DCA.AccountSK = DA.AccountSK
LEFT JOIN DW.FactSecurityPortfolio SP ON DCA.AccountSK = SP.AccountSK AND SP.BusinessDateSK=(SELECT MAX(BusinessDateSK) FROM DW.FactSecurityPortfolio)
WHERE DA.AccountStatus != 'C'
AND DCA.ShareIndicator = 'Y'
AND DC.CurrentIndicator = 1 AND DCA.CurrentIndicator = 1 AND DA.CurrentIndicator = 1 ---UPDATED_20230721
GROUP BY DC.CustomerSK,DC.CustomerId
)

,FactTreasuryOutstandingInvestment_TOI AS (
SELECT
MAX(TOI.BusinessDateSK) AS BusinessDateSK
,DC.CustomerSK AS CustomerSK
,DC.CustomerId AS CustomerId
,SUM(TOI.OutstandingInvestmentProrated) AS TreasuryOutstandingInvestment
,SUM(TOI.OutstandingInvestmentFull) AS TreasuryOutstandingInvestment_Full
FROM DW.DimCustomer DC
LEFT JOIN DW.DimCustomerAccount DCA ON DC.CustomerSK = DCA.CustomerSK
LEFT JOIN DW.DimAccount DA ON DCA.AccountSK = DA.AccountSK
LEFT JOIN DW.FactTreasuryOutstandingInvestment TOI ON DCA.AccountSK = TOI.AccountSK AND TOI.BusinessDateSK=(SELECT MAX(BusinessDateSK) FROM DW.FactTreasuryOutstandingInvestment)
WHERE DCA.ShareIndicator = 'Y'
AND DC.CurrentIndicator = 1 AND DCA.CurrentIndicator = 1 AND DA.CurrentIndicator = 1 ---UPDATED_20230721
GROUP BY DC.CustomerSK,DC.CustomerId
)

,FactTrustFundValue_TFV AS (
SELECT
MAX(TFV.BusinessDateSK) AS BusinessDateSK
,DC.CustomerSK AS CustomerSK
,DC.CustomerId AS CustomerId
,SUM(TFV.AUMAmountProrated) AS TrustFundValue
,SUM(TFV.AUMAmountFull) AS TrustFundValue_Full
FROM DW.DimCustomer DC
LEFT JOIN DW.DimCustomerAccount DCA ON DC.CustomerSK = DCA.CustomerSK
LEFT JOIN DW.DimAccount DA ON DCA.AccountSK = DA.AccountSK
LEFT JOIN DW.FactTrustFundValue TFV ON DCA.AccountSK = TFV.AccountSK AND TFV.BusinessDateSK=(SELECT MAX(BusinessDateSK) FROM DW.FactTrustFundValue)
WHERE DCA.ShareIndicator = 'Y'
AND DC.CurrentIndicator = 1 AND DCA.CurrentIndicator = 1 AND DA.CurrentIndicator = 1 ---UPDATED_20230721
GROUP BY DC.CustomerSK,DC.CustomerId
)

,FactTotalRelationshipExposure_TRE AS (
SELECT
TRE.BusinessDateSK AS BusinessDateSK
,DC.CustomerSK AS CustomerSK
,TRE.TotalRelationshipExposureProrated AS TotalRelationshipExposure
,TRE.TotalRelationshipExposureFull AS TotalRelationshipExposureFull---UPDATED_20230720
FROM DW.DimCustomer DC
LEFT JOIN DW.FactTotalRelationshipExposure TRE ON DC.CustomerSK = TRE.CustomerSK
WHERE TRE.BusinessDateSk = '20230601'---should be equal to latest Business Date in PROD
)


,FactTotalRelationshipBalance_TRB AS (
SELECT
TRB.BusinessDateSK AS BusinessDateSK
,DC.CustomerSK AS CustomerSK
,TRB.TotalRelationshipBalanceProrated AS TotalRelationshipBalance
,TRB.ProratedMarketSegmentSK
,TRB.TotalRelationshipBalanceFull AS TotalRelationshipBalanceFull---UPDATED_20230720
,TRB.FullMarketSegmentSK---UPDATED_20230720
FROM DW.DimCustomer DC
LEFT JOIN DW.FactTotalRelationshipBalance TRB ON DC.CustomerSK = TRB.CustomerSK
WHERE TRB.BusinessDateSK = '20230601'---should be equal to latest Business Date in PROD
)

,FactTotalCustomerHoldings AS (
SELECT 
'20230209' AS BusinessDateSK
,DC.CustomerSK AS CustomerSK
,DC.CustomerID AS CustomerID
,DC.GlobalCIF AS GlobalCIF
,DC.FCBSCIF AS FCBSCIF
,DC.BankSK AS BankSK
,MTD.AverageDailyBalanceMonthToDate AS AverageDailyBalanceMonthToDate
,YTD.AverageDailyBalanceYearToDate AS AverageDailyBalanceYearToDate
,YTD.AverageDailyBalanceYearToDate_Full AS AverageDailyBalanceYearToDate_Full
,DOB.DepositsOutstandingBalance AS DepositsOutstandingBalance
,LRE.LoansRelationshipExposure AS LoansRelationshipExposure
,LRE.LoansRelationshipExposureFull AS LoansRelationshipExposureFull
,LOB.LoansOutstanstandingBalance AS LoansOutstanstandingBalance
,LOB.LoansOutstanstandingBalanceFull AS LoansOutstanstandingBalanceFull
,LCL.LoansCreditLimit AS LoansCreditLimit
,LCL.LoansCreditLimitFull AS LoansCreditLimitFull
,CCL.CardsCreditLimit AS CardsCreditLimit
,COB.CardsStatementBalance AS CardsStatementBalance
,CRE.CardsRelationshipExposure AS CardsRelationshipExposure
,SP.SecuritiesPortfolio AS SecuritiesPortfolio
,TOI.TreasuryOutstandingInvestment AS TreasuryOutstandingInvestment
,TOI.TreasuryOutstandingInvestment_Full AS TreasuryOutstandingInvestment_Full
,TFV.TrustFundValue AS TrustFundValue
,TFV.TrustFundValue_Full AS TrustFundValue_Full
,TRE.TotalRelationshipExposure
,TRE.TotalRelationshipExposureFull AS TotalRelationshipExposureFull---UPDATED_20230720
,TRB.TotalRelationshipBalance
,TRB.TotalRelationshipBalanceFull AS TotalRelationshipBalanceFull---UPDATED_20230720
,CASE
	WHEN TRB.TotalRelationshipBalance >= DMS.LowerLimit THEN DMS.MarketSegmentName 
	WHEN TRB.TotalRelationshipBalance < DMS.UpperLimit THEN DMS.MarketSegmentName 
	END AS MarketSegment
,CASE---UPDATED_20230720
	WHEN TRB.TotalRelationshipBalanceFull >= DMS.LowerLimit THEN DMS.MarketSegmentName ---UPDATED_20230720
	WHEN TRB.TotalRelationshipBalanceFull < DMS.UpperLimit THEN DMS.MarketSegmentName ---UPDATED_20230720
	END AS MarketSegmentFull---UPDATED_20230720
,DC.SourceSystemCode AS SourceSystemCode
FROM DW.DimCustomer DC
LEFT JOIN FactAverageDailyBalanceMTD_MTD MTD ON DC.CustomerSK = MTD.CustomerSK
LEFT JOIN FactAverageDailyBalanceYTD_YTD YTD ON DC.CustomerSK = YTD.CustomerSK
LEFT JOIN FactDepositsOutstandingBalance_DOB DOB ON DC.CustomerSK = DOB.CustomerSK
LEFT JOIN FactLoansRelationshipExposure_LRE LRE ON DC.CustomerSK = LRE.CustomerSK
LEFT JOIN FactLoansOutstandingBalance_LOB LOB ON DC.CustomerSK = LOB.CustomerSK
LEFT JOIN FactLoansCreditLimit_LCL LCL ON DC.CustomerSK = LCL.CustomerSK
LEFT JOIN FactCardsCreditLimit_CCL CCL ON DC.CustomerSK = CCL.CustomerSK
LEFT JOIN FactCardsOutstandingBalance_COB COB ON DC.CustomerSK = COB.CustomerSK
LEFT JOIN FactCardsRelationshipExposure_CRE CRE ON DC.CustomerSK = CRE.CustomerSK
LEFT JOIN FactSecurityPortfolio_SP SP ON DC.CustomerSK = SP.CustomerSK
LEFT JOIN FactTreasuryOutstandingInvestment_TOI TOI ON DC.CustomerSK = TOI.CustomerSK
LEFT JOIN FactTrustFundValue_TFV TFV ON DC.CustomerSK = TFV.CustomerSK
LEFT JOIN FactTotalRelationshipExposure_TRE TRE ON DC.CustomerSK = TRE.CustomerSK
LEFT JOIN FactTotalRelationshipBalance_TRB TRB ON DC.CustomerSK = TRB.CustomerSK
LEFT JOIN DW.DimMarketSegment DMS ON TRB.ProratedMarketSegmentSK = DMS.MarketSegmentSK
)

, FCBSCIF AS (
SELECT A.BusinessDateSK, A.CustomerSK, A.CustomerID, A.GlobalCIF, A.FCBSCIF, A.BankSK 
        ,B.AverageDailyBalanceMonthToDate
        ,B.AverageDailyBalanceYearToDate
        ,B.AverageDailyBalanceYearToDateFull
        ,B.DepositsOutstandingBalance
        ,B.LoansRelationshipExposure
        ,B.LoansRelationshipExposureFull
        ,B.LoansOutstanstandingBalance
        ,B.LoansOutstanstandingBalanceFull
        ,B.LoansCreditLimit
        ,B.LoansCreditLimitFull
        ,B.CardsCreditLimit
        ,B.CardsStatementBalance
        ,B.CardsRelationshipExposure
        ,B.SecuritiesPortfolio
        ,B.TreasuryOutstandingInvestment
        ,B.TreasuryOutstandingInvestmentFull
        ,B.TrustFundValue
        ,B.TrustFundValueFull
        ,B.TotalRelationshipExposure
        ,B.TotalRelationshipExposureFull
        ,B.TotalRelationshipBalance
        ,B.TotalRelationshipBalanceFull
        ,CASE WHEN DMS.MarketSegmentSK IS NULL AND B.TotalRelationshipBalance >= 10000000 THEN 'VIP'    
            WHEN DMS.MarketSegmentSK IS NULL AND B.TotalRelationshipBalance < 1 THEN 'MM' ELSE DMS.MarketSegmentName
        	END AS MarketSegment
        ,CASE WHEN DMSF.MarketSegmentSK IS NULL AND B.TotalRelationshipBalanceFull >= 10000000 THEN 'VIP'    
            WHEN DMSF.MarketSegmentSK IS NULL AND B.TotalRelationshipBalanceFull < 1 THEN 'MM' ELSE DMS.MarketSegmentName
        	END AS MarketSegmentFull
        ,A.SourceSystemCode
    FROM (SELECT * FROM FactTotalCustomerHoldings WHERE FCBSCIF IS NOT NULL) A
LEFT JOIN
(SELECT
    FCBSCIF
    ,SUM(AverageDailyBalanceMonthToDate) AS AverageDailyBalanceMonthToDate
    ,SUM(AverageDailyBalanceYearToDate) AS AverageDailyBalanceYearToDate
    ,SUM(AverageDailyBalanceYearToDate_Full) AS AverageDailyBalanceYearToDateFull
    ,SUM(DepositsOutstandingBalance) AS DepositsOutstandingBalance
    ,SUM(LoansRelationshipExposure) AS LoansRelationshipExposure
    ,SUM(LoansRelationshipExposureFull) AS LoansRelationshipExposureFull
    ,SUM(LoansOutstanstandingBalance) AS LoansOutstanstandingBalance
    ,SUM(LoansOutstanstandingBalanceFull) AS LoansOutstanstandingBalanceFull
    ,SUM(LoansCreditLimit) AS LoansCreditLimit
    ,SUM(LoansCreditLimitFull) AS LoansCreditLimitFull
    ,SUM(CardsCreditLimit) AS CardsCreditLimit
    ,SUM(CardsStatementBalance) AS CardsStatementBalance
    ,SUM(CardsRelationshipExposure) AS CardsRelationshipExposure
    ,SUM(SecuritiesPortfolio) AS SecuritiesPortfolio
    ,SUM(TreasuryOutstandingInvestment) AS TreasuryOutstandingInvestment
    ,SUM(TreasuryOutstandingInvestment_Full) AS TreasuryOutstandingInvestmentFull
    ,SUM(TrustFundValue) AS TrustFundValue
    ,SUM(TrustFundValue_Full) AS TrustFundValueFull
    ,SUM(TotalRelationshipExposure) AS TotalRelationshipExposure
    ,SUM(TotalRelationshipExposureFull) AS TotalRelationshipExposureFull
    ,SUM(TotalRelationshipBalance) AS TotalRelationshipBalance
    ,SUM(TotalRelationshipBalanceFull) AS TotalRelationshipBalanceFull
    FROM FactTotalCustomerHoldings
    WHERE FCBSCIF IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY FCBSCIF) B
    ON A.FCBSCIF = B.FCBSCIF
    LEFT JOIN DW.DimMarketSegment DMS ON DMS.LowerLimit <= B.TotalRelationshipBalance AND B.TotalRelationshipBalance < DMS.UpperLimit
    LEFT JOIN DW.DimMarketSegment DMSF ON DMSF.LowerLimit <= B.TotalRelationshipBalanceFull AND B.TotalRelationshipBalanceFull < DMSF.UpperLimit
)
, NoFCBSCIF AS (
    SELECT
    BusinessDateSK, CustomerSK, CustomerID,GlobalCIF, FCBSCIF, BankSK 
        ,AverageDailyBalanceMonthToDate,AverageDailyBalanceYearToDate,AverageDailyBalanceYearToDate_Full AS AverageDailyBalanceYearToDateFull,DepositsOutstandingBalance
        ,LoansRelationshipExposure,LoansRelationshipExposureFull,LoansOutstanstandingBalance,LoansOutstanstandingBalanceFull,LoansCreditLimit,LoansCreditLimitFull
        ,CardsCreditLimit,CardsStatementBalance,CardsRelationshipExposure
        ,SecuritiesPortfolio
        ,TreasuryOutstandingInvestment,TreasuryOutstandingInvestment_Full AS TreasuryOutstandingInvestmentFull
        ,TrustFundValue,TrustFundValue_Full AS TrustFundValueFull
        ,TotalRelationshipExposure,TotalRelationshipExposureFull
        ,TotalRelationshipBalance,TotalRelationshipBalanceFull
        ,CASE WHEN DMS.MarketSegmentSK IS NULL AND TotalRelationshipBalance >= 10000000 THEN 'VIP'    
            WHEN DMS.MarketSegmentSK IS NULL AND TotalRelationshipBalance < 1 THEN 'MM' ELSE DMS.MarketSegmentName
        	END AS MarketSegment
        ,CASE WHEN DMSF.MarketSegmentSK IS NULL AND TotalRelationshipBalanceFull >= 10000000 THEN 'VIP'    
            WHEN DMSF.MarketSegmentSK IS NULL AND TotalRelationshipBalanceFull < 1 THEN 'MM' ELSE DMS.MarketSegmentName
        	END AS MarketSegmentFull
        ,A.SourceSystemCode
    FROM (SELECT * FROM FactTotalCustomerHoldings WHERE FCBSCIF IS NULL) A
    LEFT JOIN DW.DimMarketSegment DMS ON DMS.LowerLimit <= TotalRelationshipBalance AND TotalRelationshipBalance < DMS.UpperLimit
    LEFT JOIN DW.DimMarketSegment DMSF ON DMSF.LowerLimit <= TotalRelationshipBalanceFull AND TotalRelationshipBalanceFull < DMSF.UpperLimit
)
,[Result] AS (
    SELECT * FROM FCBSCIF
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM NoFCBSCIF
)

INSERT INTO dw.FactAggTotalCustomerHoldings (
    BusinessDateSK
    ,CustomerSK
    ,CustomerID
    ,GlobalCIF
    ,FCBSCIF
    ,BankSK
    ,AverageDailyBalanceMonthToDate
    ,AverageDailyBalanceYearToDate
    ,AverageDailyBalanceYearToDateFull
    ,DepositsOutstandingBalance
    ,LoansRelationshipExposure
    ,LoansRelationshipExposureFull
    ,LoansOutstanstandingBalance
    ,LoansOutstanstandingBalanceFull
    ,LoansCreditLimit
    ,LoansCreditLimitFull
    ,CardsCreditLimit
    ,CardsStatementBalance
    ,CardsRelationshipExposure
    ,SecuritiesPortfolio
    ,TreasuryOutstandingInvestment
    ,TreasuryOutstandingInvestmentFull
    ,TrustFundValue
    ,TrustFundValueFull
    ,TotalRelationshipExposure
    ,TotalRelationshipExposureFull
    ,TotalRelationshipBalance
    ,TotalRelationshipBalanceFull
    ,MarketSegment
    ,MarketSegmentFull
    ,SourceSystemCode
)
    SELECT 
    BusinessDateSK
    ,CustomerSK
    ,CustomerID
    ,GlobalCIF
    ,FCBSCIF
    ,BankSK
    ,AverageDailyBalanceMonthToDate
    ,AverageDailyBalanceYearToDate
    ,AverageDailyBalanceYearToDateFull
    ,DepositsOutstandingBalance
    ,LoansRelationshipExposure
    ,LoansRelationshipExposureFull
    ,LoansOutstanstandingBalance
    ,LoansOutstanstandingBalanceFull
    ,LoansCreditLimit
    ,LoansCreditLimitFull
    ,CardsCreditLimit
    ,CardsStatementBalance
    ,CardsRelationshipExposure
    ,SecuritiesPortfolio
    ,TreasuryOutstandingInvestment
    ,TreasuryOutstandingInvestmentFull
    ,TrustFundValue
    ,TrustFundValueFull
    ,TotalRelationshipExposure
    ,TotalRelationshipExposureFull
    ,TotalRelationshipBalance
    ,TotalRelationshipBalanceFull
    ,MarketSegment
    ,MarketSegmentFull
    ,SourceSystemCode
    FROM [Result]

----SELECT BusinessDateSK, COUNT(*) FROM [Result] GROUP BY BusinessDateSK
